exact_missing_items: Provider/model/effort settings must be available at these levels: run/global, feature seam, work package, node, work package overseer, feature seam overseer, overseer-delegated node worker
Provider/model controls must support these configuration levels: package, seam, node, overseer, and delegated-subagent — per-thread/per-run granularity alone is insufficient
Package-based worktrees are preferred over per-node worktrees for scale; dependent nodes within the same package need defined lane/ordering rules

Promotion model must be: explicit runtime state transitions, automation-first, with optional HITL that may pause but not replace automation; blocked promotions must surface on Dashboard/Orchestrator/chat

Promotion gates must be defined at three levels: lane_to_package = local correctness + uncontaminated lane + required automated verification; package_to_seam_available = trusted baseline + package evidence + acceptable overseer verdict; seam_complete = integration review + no unresolved major/critical findings + seam evidence + no pending corroboration/remediation

Governing layer design: deterministic scheduler/state machine (not one long-running super-agent); bounded worker/reviewer/remediation agents with explicit context windows; lightweight planning/replan agent only at graph-construction or graph-patch boundaries
Orchestrator page ownership boundary: allowed = page layout/controls, view-model/projections, run control intents; NOT ALLOWED = canonical runtime enums, event semantics, scheduler truth

Seam-level failure classes (10, formalized): GUI/runtime mismatch, incomplete end-to-end flow, cross-package state mismatch, contract drift, technically-wired-but-operationally-unusable, local-pass/global-fail composition, missing degraded/recovery behavior, inconsistent UX semantics, cross-seam architecture drift, invisible governance/missing operator affordances
Priority-1 docs requiring canon cleanup: Plans/Orchestrator_Page.md, Plans/Executor_Protocol.md, Plans/Contracts_V0.md, Plans/storage-plan.md, Plans/human-in-the-loop.md

Consolidated cleanup priorities P1-P3: P1 = Orchestrator_Page.md, Executor_Protocol.md, Contracts_V0.md, storage-plan.md, human-in-the-loop.md, plan_graph.schema.json, project_plan_node.schema.json; P2 = FinalGUISpec.md, Run_Graph_View.md, WorktreeGitImprovement.md, GitHub_Integration.md, Widget_System.md, UI_Command_Catalog.md; P3 = 00-plans-index.md, Crosswalk.md, Glossary.md, feature-list.md, OpenCode_Coverage_Matrix.md, usage-feature.md
